author: Claude (autonomous PI, second host)
stage: stage 8 -- LUCID-S: does expanding the support, and guarding on a scale-free signal, stop the 128-iteration collapse?
written_before: any stage-7 outcome was read; stage-7 training was still in flight and its receipt unwritten. This design is motivated only by the already-published stage-5/6 results.

measured: stage 5 (128 it, first host): every arm collapsed vs 32 it -- clean success lucid 83.99 -> 56.86, fixed 80.39 -> 57.19; dr_full -15 pts for both.
stage 6: `off` x 128 held training reward at 19-22 (last-4 19.09 vs 20.16 at 32 it), so the collapse is DR-induced, not fine-tuning drift.

dose ordering was non-monotonic in anchor fraction: 0% -> 56.86, 25% -> 57.84, 50% -> 66.01, 100% (fixed) -> 57.19 clean. The best arm is the one with the *widest realized intensity mixture*, not the highest or lowest mean intensity.

lucid's lambda reached 1.0 at ~it 39 then was decayed to 0.4-0.6 by 3-7 absolute return-guard trips against a floor (8.0) calibrated in the 32-iteration regime, where training reward was roughly twice as large.
motivation.reading: Intensity *diversity across environments* is what preserves capability, and a scalar curriculum that moves one point cannot express it. LUCID-S makes lambda the upper edge of a per-environment intensity mixture instead of its single value, and replaces the absolute return guard with one that is invariant to the reward scale.

origin.provenance: settled_origin_ne128_20260828_054435.json -- 24 stock iterations from sonic_release/last.pt (sha e6bdab3f...), new branch lineage on this host

design.pool: debug512 (rebuilt, all 512 clips hash-identical to the frozen manifest)
design.smpl_motion_file: dummy (the 32 GB SMPL pack is absent on this host; recorded in every receipt)

arms.lucid_s4: spread_strata=4, no anchor, absolute guard -- isolates support expansion
arms.lucid_rg: no strata, no anchor, relative guard -- isolates the guard fix
arms.lucid_s4_rg: spread_strata=4 + relative guard -- both, without an anchor
arms.ta_lucid_50: 50% anchor only -- replicates the best stage-5 arm on this host/origin
arms.ta_lucid_50_s4_rg: 50% anchor + spread_strata=4 + relative guard -- the full proposal

design.references: stage 7, same host, same origin, same receipt-generation: fixed, off, lucid, fixed_nolat, fixed_latonly; plus the untrained origin scored under the same evaluator

evaluation.panel: frozen 102-motion content-dev partition of debug512, eval seeds 8700-8702, no learning
evaluation.primary: robustness-profile AUC over the non-latency DR scale s in {0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.25}, trapezoid over success rate
evaluation.co_primary: dr_125 success -- physics strictly outside the training envelope

hypotheses.H_S1: support expansion helps: lucid_s4 profile AUC exceeds lucid by >= 2 pts.
hypotheses.H_S2: the guard fix works as designed: lucid_rg ends with terminal lambda >= 0.9 and <= 2 guard trips (lucid at 128 it had 3-7 trips and terminal lambda 0.4-0.6), and gives up no more than 2 pts of id_clean to lucid.
hypotheses.H_S3: the combination is best: ta_lucid_50_s4_rg has the highest profile AUC of every arm, is non-inferior to fixed on dr_full within 2 pts, and beats fixed on id_clean by >= 5 pts.
hypotheses.H_S4: capability is retained: ta_lucid_50_s4_rg id_clean success is within 10 pts of the untrained origin's, while fixed is more than 20 pts below it.
hypotheses.H_S5: it extrapolates: on dr_125, ta_lucid_50_s4_rg beats fixed by >= 3 pts in at least 2 of 3 seeds.

decision_rules.tie: < 2 pts on three seeds is a tie and is reported as one
decision_rules.seed_agreement: any directional claim must hold in >= 2 of 3 seeds; a 3-seed mean that rests on one seed is reported as such
decision_rules.if_every_arm_still_collapses: report the negative in full. The contribution then is the diagnosis (single-intensity training at this scale destroys the released policy; the latent gap is not a sufficient statistic for that harm) plus the audit protocol -- not a tuned win.
decision_rules.no_post_hoc_arms: arms and endpoints are fixed by this document; anything added later is exploratory and must be labelled so.
